books.basis: Owner explicitly authorized nine books and current editions. The Mayon Paradox is excluded. EPUB SHA-256 pins and per-unit hashes are in the public metadata; paid text is excluded from Git and public discovery examples. The newer Cosmic Recursion voice revision dated 2026-10-15 supersedes its earlier EPUB. Plain reading text only; no training, redistribution or factual-certification rights.
books.delivery: Private server-function assets only; no Supabase or external asset-storage service. Validate edition, unit hash and byte length before settlement. Prepared paid output retained for 24 hours.

religion.basis: Reviewed lib/x402/micro-next-religion.ts and its pinned public registries. Outputs contain Maha-authored source-separated summaries, source locators and declared boundaries, not translation/verse/full-source text. The source accessor rejects uninspected sources and NC/non-commercial representations. Namesake ambiguity and reception-vs-ancestry limits remain explicit. Existing registry digests are checked at execution.

publisherSources.basis: lib/x402/demand6/sources.ts restricts excerpts to three Maha-owned public pages. No external copyrighted source is added. Up to three allowlisted sources, bounded public-DNS-pinned HTTPS transport, no redirects, credentials, private addresses, PDF or script execution. Extractive microbrief uses short exact quotes and locations; zero model calls. Payment preflight performs an unpaid quote inspection only; quote validity is not settlement or delivery.

researchMetadata.basis: Crossref permits use of bibliographic metadata for any purpose while warning that abstracts may be copyrighted. Only bounded titles, IDs, dates, funding/relation/update metadata are returned; no abstracts, authors or full text. ClinicalTrials.gov output is limited to identifier, overall status and last-update date. Attribute ClinicalTrials.gov/NLM and disclaim endorsement and guaranteed currentness. No descriptions, contacts, participant data or attachments. Sources are official, URL/DNS pinned and redirect-free, with 25-second execution and 128-KiB per-response limits. No paid source APIs. Provider metadata is not independently verified fact or medical guidance.

publishing.basis: Caller-supplied public/synthetic artifacts and reference metadata only. The user explicitly approved replacing local draft retrieval/comparison with database-free pin validation/artifact comparison. No local SQLite journal, unpublished editorial drafts, source fetching or models. Content/license hashes are checked; outputs do not grant publication rights or certify truth. Thirty-day retained output and 90-day minimal receipt metadata, no automatic correction subscription.

models.mpsReplacement: Owner-approved CPU-only provenance-contract audit at unchanged 0.100002 USDC. Caller-declared VERIFIED tags are not independently verified.
